title: Correction trained jointly with the training devices' cards (alternating refit and retrain), REAL_DEV leave-one-device-out
iteration: exploration iteration 2, direction I2-1 (follow-up of E1)
status: pre-registered before any M_joint, T1_joint or ORACLE_joint correction was trained or scored. Smoke runs at reduced budget (output directories named smoke_*) check the code only and are not used for the decision

parent.stage1: out/research/explore/E1/real_dev_lodo/results.json (post-hoc, fixed cards): C0 0.1073, T1 0.0865, M 0.1276 all-device mean
parent.stage2: out/research/explore/E1/real_dev_refit/results.json (held-out card refit with the stage-1 fold correction in the loop): C0 refit 0.10719, M 0.08708, T1 0.08198 all-device mean; 0 failed

hypothesis: Residuals of cards fit without a correction mix per-device parameter error with the shared model-form error. Training the correction jointly with the training devices' cards (alternating: refit each training card with the current correction in the loop, then retrain the correction on the refit residuals, K rounds) makes the learned term carry the shared component, so it lowers the strict paper RRMS of a held-out device whose card is then refit with the frozen correction, relative to the E1 stage-2 correction (M_post).

data.devices: REAL_DEV (12) from out/research/explore/real_split.json; REAL_TEST is not loaded by any I2_1 script
data.records: out/research/explore/E1/real_dev.{npz,json} (E1 DeviceRec records: measured curves, frozen inclusion, trim, denominators, simulation of the starting card)
data.starting_cards: out/research/polished/direct43_r3_fd/real/summary.json (direct NGSpice 43-parameter fit, round 3 + FD polish), the same cards E1 used
data.box: round-3 43-parameter box, out/cold_loop/full_direct/round_3/spec.json (cold_loop.box_for), as in E1 stage 2

correction_model.M: identical to E1 M, frozen: I_corr = I_bsim * exp(g), g = 1.0 * tanh(h(phi)); MLP 6-32-32-1, tanh hidden activations, last layer initialized to zero, L2 1e-4 on weights, Adam lr 3e-3, 2000 full-batch steps, float64, ensemble of 5 seeds (0-4) averaging g; features phi = [is_pmos, |Vgs|/1.85 V, |Vds|/1.85 V, log10 L_um, log10 W_um, log10(|I_bsim| L / W + 1e-13)], continuous features standardized with the mean/std of the training points of the current fold and round; loss = mean over training devices of the paper per-device RRMS of the corrected current + L2 (cryoml.explore.e1_correction.fit_arm, HYPER['M'])
correction_model.T1: identical to E1 T1: one scalar log-gain per (family, curve tag), 1.0 * tanh, Adam lr 2e-2, 1000 steps, same loss; a group absent from training gets 0. Not deployable as a device model (uses the curve tag)
correction_model.retraining: at every round the correction is trained from scratch (same initialization and seeds), not fine-tuned

joint_training.round_0: g_0 = the E1 stage-1 fold correction of the same arm (out/research/explore/E1/real_dev_lodo/fold_corrections.json), trained on the 11 training devices' residuals of the starting cards; training cards c_0 = starting cards
joint_training.round_r_for_r_1_to_K: each training card is refit with g_{r-1} in the loop: ngspice_fit.polish warm-started from c_{r-1}, max_nfev 150, irls 1, diff_step 0.01, same box, every NGSpice simulation passed through g_{r-1}; c_r = the best card seen; one fresh NGSpice simulation of c_r on the measured grid gives the round-r training records; g_r = correction trained from scratch on those records
joint_training.held_out_refit: after round K the held-out card is refit from its starting card with the frozen g_K in the loop: ngspice_fit.polish max_nfev 400, irls 2, diff_step 0.01 (the E1 stage-2 settings); the best card is re-simulated, corrected with g_K and scored
joint_training.folds: leave-one-device-out over the 12 REAL_DEV devices; the held-out device's data are not used in any round of its fold

arms.C0_refit: control: held-out card refit without correction, same start and settings as the held-out refit above. Rerun; expected to reproduce E1 stage-2 C0 (0.10719 all-device mean)
arms.M_post: E1 stage-2 arm M (equivalent to K = 0); stored per-device results reused from out/research/explore/E1/real_dev_refit/results.json, not rerun
arms.M_joint: PRIMARY: joint training with M, K = 3, then held-out refit with g_K
arms.T1_joint: non-deployable comparator: the same joint loop and held-out refit with T1
arms.ORACLE_joint: diagnostic only, not a held-out result: the joint loop run on the held-out device alone (g_0 = M trained in-sample on that device's starting-card residuals; K = 3 rounds refitting that device's card; final refit from the starting card with g_K)
arms.round_diagnostics: diagnostic only: M_joint held-out refit with g_1 and g_2; for every round r of M_joint and T1_joint, the post-hoc held-out score of g_r on the starting card's simulation (no refit) and the training-device mean RRMS with g_{r-1} on c_r and with g_r on c_r

evaluation.metric: strict paper RRMS with frozen published-baseline curve inclusion: e1_correction.score_device (metrics.device_rrms_new with the record's frozen include tags); a non-finite included curve makes the device NaN
evaluation.aggregates: all-device mean over the 12 devices (primary), combined = mean of the nMOS and pMOS family means, median, per-device values
evaluation.final_currents: every scored current is a fresh NGSpice simulation of the refit card multiplied by exp(g) of the frozen correction

continue_if_all: M_joint all-device mean <= T1_joint all-device mean + 0.005
criterion.kill_otherwise: I2_1 is stopped if any condition above fails

simulated_arm.role: secondary; reported with the I2_1 outcome; does not change the REAL_DEV decision
simulated_arm.targets: GF180 (BSIM4) and IHP SG13G2 (PSP103) tier c truth sets 0-2, 48 targets per PDK; records out/research/explore/E1/{gf180,ihp}_c_set{0,1,2}.{npz,json}; starting cards = the E1 fitted cards stored in the records (wide box: GF180 21 parameters, IHP 12)
simulated_arm.features: same phi with VDD = 3.3 V (GF180) or 1.2 V (IHP)
simulated_arm.folds: leave-one-geometry-out, 16 folds per PDK (all three draws of the held-out geometry removed from training in every round)
simulated_arm.joint_training: as on REAL_DEV: g_0 = E1 leave-one-geometry-out fold M correction (out/research/explore/E1/{pdk}_c_logo/fold_corrections.json); K = 3; training refits Pdk2Problem + ngspice_fit.polish warm-started, max_nfev 150, irls 1, diff_step 0.01; held-out refit from the E1 fitted card, max_nfev 400, irls 2, diff_step 0.01
simulated_arm.arms: C0_refit (no correction), M_post (held-out refit with g_0; new run, since E1 had no in-loop refit on the simulated sets), M_joint (K = 3). T1_joint is not run on the simulated sets (compute budget)
simulated_arm.metric: pdk2.metric paper RRMS (target-frozen inclusion) via e1_correction.score_device, strict NaN on a non-finite included curve; all-target mean (equal to combined: 24 nMOS, 24 pMOS)
simulated_arm.check: M_joint all-target mean <= 0.90 x C0_refit all-target mean, per PDK. Also reported: M_post / C0_refit ratio and per-target win counts

identifiability_diagnostic.components: for each held-out target, from the truth card (truth.json of the tier-c set) simulated with NGSpice on the target's bias grid: c_param = ln|I(fitted + misspecified non-fitted parameters, Rs = 0, 27 C)| - ln|I(fitted parameters only, Rs = 0, 27 C)|; c_rs = ln|I(truth card, Rs)| - ln|I(truth card, Rs = 0)| at 27 C; c_heat = ln|I(truth card, Rs, per-curve heating temperatures)| - ln|I(truth card, Rs, 27 C)|; c_gain = ln(per-curve gain); c_sum = their sum
identifiability_diagnostic.points: included curves, trimmed points (start onward); points with a non-finite logarithm or |I| < 1e-13 A in any term are excluded
identifiability_diagnostic.statistics: per PDK and arm (M_post, M_joint), pooled over held-out targets: Pearson r of g (the arm's correction evaluated on its final refit card's simulation) with c_param, c_rs, c_heat, c_gain, c_sum and with the observed residual ln|target / I_card|; OLS of g on [1, c_param, c_rs, c_heat, c_gain] (coefficients, R^2); mean per-target Pearson r with c_sum

compute.real: one queue job, process pool (4 workers, 1 torch thread each), rounds synchronized across folds
compute.simulated: one queue job per PDK, process pool (6 workers)
compute.smoke: 2 folds, K = 1, reduced nfev and M steps/seeds; output smoke_* directories, labelled smoke, not used for any conclusion

frozen_choices_note: All choices above were fixed before any I2_1 joint-arm result existed. No REAL_DEV result is used to change them; any later variant gets a new id or a dated amendment that leaves this file unchanged
